text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and stimulation. The modern glass doors suggest a space devoted to openness and innovation, while the vibrant wall and interactive screens inside highlight an energetic embrace of knowledge and creativity. The concept of 'R+D' (Research and Development) displayed so prominently makes me reflect on our collective drive to explore, question, and improve the world around us. I am both introspective and inspired, eager to see what new ideas might be sparked in this space.
